newsitem.title: USA: Intermedia in pact with Cable & Wireless.
newsitem.headline: Intermedia in pact with Cable & Wireless.

text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc Tuesday said it has signed a contract to provide Cable & Wireless Inc, with switched access termination and origination for interstate long-distance services.

Intermedia said the two-year agreement will cover up to 10 Local Access Transport Areas in Florida and could generate about $10 million a year if fully implemented. Full implementation is expected by the second quarter, 1997.
The contract is to begin in Miami in November. The companies expect terminating traffic alone from Miami to generate approximately $4 million in revenue over two years.
Cable & Wireless Inc is owned by Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc.
